en: Proverbs 1

p.src: 1  The proverbs of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel:

en: The proverbs of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel:
u.src: 1  The proverbs of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel:

p.src: 2  to know wisdom and instruction; to discern the words of understanding;

en: to know wisdom and instruction; to discern the words of understanding;
u.src: 2  to know wisdom and instruction; to discern the words of understanding;

p.src: 3  to receive instruction in wise dealing, in righteousness, justice, and equity;

en: to receive instruction in wise dealing, in righteousness, justice, and equity;
u.src: 3  to receive instruction in wise dealing, in righteousness, justice, and equity;

p.src: 4  to give prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the young man—

en: to give prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the young man—
u.src: 4  to give prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the young man—

p.src: 5  that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel;

en: that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel;
u.src: 5  that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel;

p.src: 6  to understand a proverb and parables, the words and riddles of the wise.

en: to understand a proverb and parables, the words and riddles of the wise.
u.src: 6  to understand a proverb and parables, the words and riddles of the wise.

p.src: 7  The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge, but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.

en: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge, but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.
u.src: 7  The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge, but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.

en: 1:7 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

p.src: 8  My son, listen to your father’s instruction, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching;

en: My son, listen to your father’s instruction, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching;
u.src: 8  My son, listen to your father’s instruction, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching;

p.src: 9  for they will be a garland to grace your head, and chains around your neck.

en: for they will be a garland to grace your head, and chains around your neck.
u.src: 9  for they will be a garland to grace your head, and chains around your neck.

p.src: 10  My son, if sinners entice you, don’t consent.

en: My son, if sinners entice you, don’t consent.
u.src: 10  My son, if sinners entice you, don’t consent.

p.src: 11  If they say, “Come with us. Let’s lie in wait for blood. Let’s lurk secretly for the innocent without cause.

en: If they say, “Come with us. Let’s lie in wait for blood. Let’s lurk secretly for the innocent without cause.
u.src: 11  If they say, “Come with us. Let’s lie in wait for blood. Let’s lurk secretly for the innocent without cause.

p.src: 12  Let’s swallow them up alive like Sheol, and whole, like those who go down into the pit.

en: Let’s swallow them up alive like Sheol, and whole, like those who go down into the pit.
u.src: 12  Let’s swallow them up alive like Sheol, and whole, like those who go down into the pit.

en: 1:12 Sheol is the place of the dead.

p.src: 13  We’ll find all valuable wealth. We’ll fill our houses with plunder.

en: We’ll find all valuable wealth. We’ll fill our houses with plunder.
u.src: 13  We’ll find all valuable wealth. We’ll fill our houses with plunder.

p.src: 14  You shall cast your lot among us. We’ll all have one purse”—

en: You shall cast your lot among us. We’ll all have one purse”—
u.src: 14  You shall cast your lot among us. We’ll all have one purse”—

p.src: 15  my son, don’t walk on the path with them. Keep your foot from their path,

en: my son, don’t walk on the path with them. Keep your foot from their path,
u.src: 15  my son, don’t walk on the path with them. Keep your foot from their path,

p.src: 16  for their feet run to evil. They hurry to shed blood.

en: for their feet run to evil. They hurry to shed blood.
u.src: 16  for their feet run to evil. They hurry to shed blood.

p.src: 17  For the net is spread in vain in the sight of any bird;

en: For the net is spread in vain in the sight of any bird;
u.src: 17  For the net is spread in vain in the sight of any bird;

p.src: 18  but these lay in wait for their own blood. They lurk secretly for their own lives.

en: but these lay in wait for their own blood. They lurk secretly for their own lives.
u.src: 18  but these lay in wait for their own blood. They lurk secretly for their own lives.

p.src: 19  So are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain. It takes away the life of its owners.

en: So are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain. It takes away the life of its owners.
u.src: 19  So are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain. It takes away the life of its owners.

p.src: 20  Wisdom calls aloud in the street. She utters her voice in the public squares.

en: Wisdom calls aloud in the street. She utters her voice in the public squares.
u.src: 20  Wisdom calls aloud in the street. She utters her voice in the public squares.

p.src: 21  She calls at the head of noisy places. At the entrance of the city gates, she utters her words:

en: She calls at the head of noisy places. At the entrance of the city gates, she utters her words:
u.src: 21  She calls at the head of noisy places. At the entrance of the city gates, she utters her words:

p.src: 22  “How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery, and fools hate knowledge?

en: “How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery, and fools hate knowledge?
u.src: 22  “How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery, and fools hate knowledge?

p.src: 23  Turn at my reproof. Behold, I will pour out my spirit on you. I will make known my words to you.

en: Turn at my reproof. Behold, I will pour out my spirit on you. I will make known my words to you.
u.src: 23  Turn at my reproof. Behold, I will pour out my spirit on you. I will make known my words to you.

en: 1:23 “Behold”, from “הִנֵּה”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.

p.src: 24  Because I have called, and you have refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no one has paid attention;

en: Because I have called, and you have refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no one has paid attention;
u.src: 24  Because I have called, and you have refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no one has paid attention;

p.src: 25  but you have ignored all my counsel, and wanted none of my reproof;

en: but you have ignored all my counsel, and wanted none of my reproof;
u.src: 25  but you have ignored all my counsel, and wanted none of my reproof;

p.src: 26  I also will laugh at your disaster. I will mock when calamity overtakes you,

en: I also will laugh at your disaster. I will mock when calamity overtakes you,
u.src: 26  I also will laugh at your disaster. I will mock when calamity overtakes you,

p.src: 27  when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when your disaster comes on like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish come on you.

en: when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when your disaster comes on like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish come on you.
u.src: 27  when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when your disaster comes on like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish come on you.

p.src: 28  Then they will call on me, but I will not answer. They will seek me diligently, but they will not find me,

en: Then they will call on me, but I will not answer. They will seek me diligently, but they will not find me,
u.src: 28  Then they will call on me, but I will not answer. They will seek me diligently, but they will not find me,

p.src: 29  because they hated knowledge, and didn’t choose the fear of the LORD.

en: because they hated knowledge, and didn’t choose the fear of the LORD.
u.src: 29  because they hated knowledge, and didn’t choose the fear of the LORD.

p.src: 30  They wanted none of my counsel. They despised all my reproof.

en: They wanted none of my counsel. They despised all my reproof.
u.src: 30  They wanted none of my counsel. They despised all my reproof.

p.src: 31  Therefore they will eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own schemes.

en: Therefore they will eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own schemes.
u.src: 31  Therefore they will eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own schemes.

p.src: 32  For the backsliding of the simple will kill them. The careless ease of fools will destroy them.

en: For the backsliding of the simple will kill them. The careless ease of fools will destroy them.
u.src: 32  For the backsliding of the simple will kill them. The careless ease of fools will destroy them.

p.src: 33  But whoever listens to me will dwell securely, and will be at ease, without fear of harm.”

en: But whoever listens to me will dwell securely, and will be at ease, without fear of harm.”
u.src: 33  But whoever listens to me will dwell securely, and will be at ease, without fear of harm.”
